change.description: Expose an independent OAuth request-compression setting and apply root/group/account OAuth compression to body-bearing upstream POST requests.
change.release_unit_description: OAuth upstream request compression support in the r4p9x account-policy release unit.

planned.reasoning: The API additions are backward-compatible, but the new OAuth default changes the default wire behavior for OAuth POST bodies and adds durable routing state; this is a compatible capability addition within the Major, not a patch-only behavior correction.

scope_drift.description: Implementation remains limited to OAuth request compression, additive settings/storage fields, policy inheritance, telemetry, UI, and focused compatibility coverage.

current.reasoning: Existing API-key compression defaults and fields remain unchanged. Missing OAuth storage resolves to zstd, old clients may omit the additive field, and older binaries can continue reading the additive SQLite column. The OAuth wire default is intentionally changed by the approved plan.
